name: Otofuke (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Otofuke town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised sprout with two leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Otofuke, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 April 1970.

features.role: Otofuke town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised sprout with two leaves
